authority.parsed_signature: forward_inference(self, image, task_id, router_features_202=None, roi_window=None, action_available=None, oof_refined_crop_prob=None, safety_post_features_16=None) -> Dict[str, Any]

arguments.name: image
arguments.clean_generation: SegmentationTransform(size=512, train=False, image_mode='RGB') from src/data/transforms.py; identical aspect-preserving BILINEAR resize + ImageOps.expand centre pad + /255.0
arguments.image_perturbation_generation: frozen image condition applied to the PRE-NORMALIZED float32 [0,1] array (common_v1_1.apply_image_condition), then re-preprocessed to the tensor
arguments.proposal_perturbation_generation: REUSED unchanged from the clean sample (clean_ref['image'][sid]); proposal perturbation never alters the image

arguments.name: task_id
arguments.semantic_source: canonical Phase4 VAL808 manifest task_id column / DOMAIN_TASK_ID

arguments.name: router_features_202
arguments.required: REQUIRED to reach the router decision (raises ValueError if None on any non-FORCED_SKIP path)
arguments.semantic_source: canonical Phase25B 202-D GT-free extractor build_feature_vector(cmaps, P, roi_row)
arguments.clean_generation: assembled from clean G taps (cmaps) + clean p_global + clean roi_row (geometry from roi_geometry(p_global, 0.30, margin=0.25))
arguments.image_perturbation_generation: REASSEMBLED from perturbed G taps + perturbed p_global (G re-run on the perturbed image) with the corresponding perturbed roi_row
arguments.proposal_perturbation_generation: REASSEMBLED from REUSED clean G taps + REUSED clean p_global, but with the PERTURBED roi_row (clip_* / crop_side_pixels) -> the 98 geometry-dependent dims differ

arguments.name: roi_window
arguments.optional_default: None (proposed internally via _roi_window_from_probability when absent and action_available is not False)
arguments.shape: tuple (y0, y1, x0, x1) half-open; None == action unavailable
arguments.semantic_source: frozen ROI proposal (threshold 0.30 -> bbox -> centre-preserving expansion ROI_EXPANSION=1.50)
arguments.clean_generation: canonical roi_geometry(p_global, 0.30, margin=0.25) -> (clip_y1, clip_y2, clip_x1, clip_x2)
arguments.image_perturbation_generation: re-derived from the perturbed p_global proposal
arguments.proposal_perturbation_generation: the PERTURBED window (shift/scale applied per frozen registry), clamped to image bounds

arguments.name: action_available
arguments.optional_default: None -> derived as (window is not None)

arguments.name: oof_refined_crop_prob
arguments.required: REQUIRED on the EXECUTE branch (raises ValueError if None after util >= tau_C8_final)
arguments.clean_generation: R_psi(rin) where rin = concat(rgb_crop(3,256,256), prob_crop(1,256,256)); sigmoid(refiner_out)[0,0]
arguments.image_perturbation_generation: R_psi over the perturbed-image crop geometry
arguments.proposal_perturbation_generation: R_psi over the PERTURBED geometry crop (clean G reused, perturbed crop window)

arguments.name: safety_post_features_16
arguments.required: REQUIRED on the EXECUTE branch (raises ValueError if None)
arguments.proposal_perturbation_generation: RECOMPUTED from the perturbed geometry crops (S_omega recomputed when EXECUTE)

wrapper_executability_assessment.rationale: forward_inference accepts router_features_202 and roi_window INDEPENDENTLY; both proposal-perturbation recomputation (204-D reassembly via the extractor) and R_psi crop/fusion feed it directly. No lower-level Phase25F/25G/26 rebinding is required.
